body:
AMEND — three concrete repairs under the anti-dither rule; otherwise I accept the finite T then A-through-F sequence and its no-authorization boundary.

1. C1-A cannot publish a checked SourceBundle or final BundleId while its complete manifest still contains mapping references that have not passed the C1-C/D canonical-relation constructors. Otherwise a public value can bind an unresolved local mapping key, or retain one identity after a gap, occurrence, epoch, or seam changes. C1-T must choose one lawful order: either A owns the complete canonical mapping-manifest representation plus every identity-normalization law needed before hashing, or A yields an explicitly unresolved manifest and final bundle/global identity is constructed only after the required mapping relations validate. A resolved reference alone is not a checked relation.

2. C1-C is the first ClockRepair/projection owner, so its total outcome must include NoCorrespondence; the posted list omits the plan section 3.2 outcome required by the F0 continuing-audio/picture-no-correspondence court. C1-C must also own the shared mapping laws for directed axes/family, relation identity versus derivation receipt, occurrence, epoch/discontinuity seams, endpoints, and ClockRepair monotonicity only within one epoch. If epochs and seams first become a D law, a completed C can construct a ClockRepair that coalesces across a seam or keeps its relation identity after seam deletion. D should add TrackComposition-specific repeats, holds, gaps, reorder and set-valued reverse plus EditionCorrespondence no-cast laws; it cannot retroactively close C.

3. C1-E needs three separate lawful families, not only reader and provider coverage: stream capability, reader coverage, and boundary-provider search coverage. The accepted F0 V3 court requires Decoded / PacketIndexedOnly / Unsupported capability to remain distinct from DecodedSupport / PacketOnlySupport / UnsupportedByReader / NoCorrespondingSample / ProcessingFailure / ReaderUnexamined, and both from provider examined / failed / abstained / unexamined / ineligible plus candidate versus ExaminedNoCandidate. Required mutations: Unsupported is not Unexamined; NoCorrespondingSample is not mapping OutsideDomain, NoCorrespondence, or gap; and empty partial, failed, abstained, ineligible, or unexamined provider coverage cannot construct ExaminedNoCandidate. Without this, one required capability state is unrepresentable and known refusal can be laundered into non-examination.

Timestamp/refusal ownership in B, boundary-family ownership in E, legacy conformance in F, and the exclusion of rights, admission, runtimes, providers, codecs, and accepted claims are otherwise correct. This AMEND grants no implementation, source, dependency, or runtime authority.
